findings.summary: Minus percentages on every fund, including the recommended one, read as losses, because the reader can't tell what the differences are measured against.
86k at the end from 70k deposited felt low, and the 'in today's money' label is easy to miss, so the main figure can be misread.
The colours in the cost bars are only explained after scrolling, and the legend is small and far from the bars.
Jargon such as custody fee, trustee and 4A has no plain explanation.
There's no clear next step for opening the account.
Large cost gaps between investment houses look alarming with no explanation.
